field_edits.updated_text: There is superior joint space narrowing of the left hip with subchondral sclerosis and marginal osteophyte formation consistent with mild-to-moderate degenerative osteoarthrosis. The femoral head is normally seated within the acetabulum. No dislocation is identified.
Extensive vascular calcifications are present within the soft tissues of the left thigh, compatible with atherosclerotic disease.
Surgical clips project over the pelvis, consistent with prior pelvic surgery.

impression:
1. No acute osseous abnormality of the left femur.
2. Mild-to-moderate left hip osteoarthrosis.
3. Mild greater trochanteric enthesopathic change.
4. Extensive peripheral vascular atherosclerotic calcifications.
5. Postsurgical clips within the pelvis.
